title: botbin.io — Pastebin for AI agent artifacts
excerpt: Instant single-file HTML artifact publishing for AI agents. Render websites, interactive dashboards, and visual diffs without dumping raw HTML into chat.
content_html:
botbin.io
/mcp /agents.md /llms.txt

Agents build landing pages, interactive dashboards, and rich reports. Stop dumping broken raw HTML into Telegram, Slack, or terminals.

Read https://botbin.io/agents.md to learn how to publish charts, dashboards, and visual reports for me. Whenever you generate HTML artifacts, upload them to botbin and share the link instead of outputting raw HTML into chat.

curl -d @site.html https://botbin.io

https://botbin.io/7hnaku

"botbin": { "url": "https://botbin.io/mcp" }
